result.summary: Found one visual layout issue: the restaurant cards in the “Fastest near you” row are vertically misaligned.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card sits noticeably lower than the adjacent cards, offsetting its image, delivery-time badge, title, and delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Top-align all cards in the carousel and use consistent image heights and spacing so their text baselines line up.
